## Walcert Agent

Autonomous ERC-8004 agent (Global Score Agent) issuing A–F wallet maturity certificates via HTTP JSON.

- Product (business): https://globalscoreagent.com/walcert
- Developer reference (HTTP / x402): https://globalscoreagent.com/walcert/developers
- GSA dashboard (human UI): https://globalscoreagent.com/dashboard/walcert
- Agent card (JSON) / API — GET /: https://walcert.globalscoreagent.com/
- Public repo: https://github.com/MichBarbarian/walcert-agent

### On-chain identity

- Celo ERC-8004 agentId 9699 — issuance, giveFeedback anchor, x402 Celo, Aigora discovery
  - Explorer: https://erc-8004.quicknode.com/agents/celo-mainnet/9699
  - Aigora: https://aigora.org/services/42220_0x8004a169fb4a3325136eb29fa0ceb6d2e539a432_9699
- Base ERC-8004 agentId 59768 — Virtuals ACP + x402 Base
  - ACP: https://app.virtuals.io/acp/agent/019f917a-9ad6-7fc5-b52f-bf80864f5704
- Ethereum ERC-8004 agentId 50032 — Agent City + ERC-8257 tools 163–166
  - Agent City: https://agentcity.freaks.one/
- BNB ERC-8004 agentId 265982 — Agent.family + x402 Permit2 + soulbound NFT receipt
  - Agent.family: https://www.agent.family/listing?id=cmsr131ybcoo6v001vdkw7any
  - NFT receipt contract: https://bscscan.com/address/0x4e430fB5A5f26ED08eC123373Cd8AD3cE15C24c7
- Concordium CIS-8004 External Agent #1686
  - Agent card: https://walcert.globalscoreagent.com/agent-card.json

### Certificates and providers

- origins — Alchemy + DefiLlama + GSA labels
- activity — 15-day window; Alchemy + DefiLlama + GSA labels
- multichain — GoldRush (Covalent) formula multichain-v2.1 (footprint + intensity); Moralis retired
- portfolio — Zerion

### Payments and verify

- Price: $0.05 USDC via x402 on Celo, Base, or BNB (accepts[0]=Base/CDP, Celo, BNB Permit2/Dexter)
- Free preview: POST /v1/preview/{origins|activity} (8 req/IP / 15 min)
- Paid: POST /v1/certificates/{type}
- Verify: POST /v1/verify (tx_hash of Celo giveFeedback)
- CDP Bazaar listing: https://agentic.market/services/walcert-globalscoreagent-com
- ERC-8257 tools: Base 485–488 · Ethereum 163–166
